changes_applied.description: Added docker-entrypoint.sh to frontend/. The entrypoint clears the frontend_dist named volume and copies fresh dist files from the image layer on every container start, preventing stale bundles.

Modified frontend/Dockerfile Stage 2 (alpine): stores built dist at /app/dist-source (image layer, never shadowed by volume mount), copies docker-entrypoint.sh, sets ENTRYPOINT. Removed unused dead-code that just copied dist to /app/dist with no entrypoint.

docker-compose.yml: removed 'target: build' from frontend service (now uses final Stage 2 with entrypoint). Added healthcheck (test: /app/dist/index.html exists, interval 2s, retries 30). Updated nginx depends_on to use service_healthy for frontend and service_started for api.

Makefile dev target: added 'docker compose rm -sf frontend' before 'docker compose up --build'. This forces the frontend container to be recreated on every make dev, guaranteeing the entrypoint always runs regardless of image cache hits.

verification_evidence.entrypoint_output: [frontend] Refreshing dist volume from image build... [frontend] Dist volume ready (49 files).

root_cause_addressed: Named Docker volumes persist across container recreations. Docker only initializes a named volume with container content when the volume is EMPTY/NEW. On subsequent 'docker compose up --build', the rebuilt image's /app/dist was shadowed by the existing (stale) volume content. The entrypoint approach bypasses this by actively overwriting the volume on every container start.
user_instructions: None. The fix is fully self-contained. 'make dev' continues to be the only command needed. ISS-001 cannot recur: every 'make dev' forces a fresh frontend container which wipes and rewrites the dist volume from the current image.
